title: Updates on Fenway Sports Group and Liverpool FC ownership
description: Recent reports suggest changes in ownership for Liverpool FC involving Fenway Sports Group and a consortium including Jeff Bezos.

sections.heading: Potential Stake Sale
paragraphs: According to The Guardian, Liverpool owners are close to a £1.35bn sale of a 30% stake to a consortium including Jeff Bezos. Sky News reports that the Amazon founder is nearing a deal to buy a stake in Liverpool Football Club. Additionally, the BBC states that a consortium including the American is advancing talks regarding Liverpool.

sections.heading: Reported Participants
paragraphs: The news coverage highlights the involvement of Jeff Bezos, identified as the Amazon founder by Sky News, in the discussions with the current owners of the football club.

faq.q: What is the reported value of the potential sale?
faq.a: According to The Guardian, the sale involves a 30% stake valued at £1.35bn.

faq.q: Who is reported to be part of the buying consortium?
faq.a: Reports from the BBC, Sky News, and The Guardian indicate that Jeff Bezos is part of the consortium.
